articleTitle: What Actually Reduces Deep Forehead Wrinkles at 30
imageHeadline: Deep forehead lines at 30? Facials won't fix them
imageSubtext: What actually works—and how long it really takes
pinTitle: What Actually Reduces Deep Forehead Wrinkles at 30 | Evidence-Based Skincare
pinDescription: Deep forehead wrinkles aren't rare at 30—but facials won't fix them. Learn which topical treatments have real research behind them (retinol, vitamin C, sunscreen) and how long consistent use actually takes to soften established lines.

items.label: Start retinol a few nights a week at night
Add vitamin C in the morning (10-15%)
Use SPF 30+ daily to protect progress
Wait 12 weeks minimum for visible results
